European football body UEFA threatens FIFA with legal action over Gianni Infantino's failed plan to sell a stake in future World Cup profits to private investors.

corpus.title: UEFA declares no confidence in FIFA leadership as pressure mounts on Infantino
corpus.signal_text:
UEFA declares no confidence in FIFA leadership as pressure mounts on Infantino

European football’s governing body has lost confidence in FIFA chief Gianni Infantino, UEFA said in a blistering statement on Saturday. The announcement followed Infantino’s U-turn over a plan sell World Cup profits to private investors.

corpus.title: English FA to drop support for Infantino's re-election
corpus.signal_text:
English FA to drop support for Infantino's re-election

The English Football Association (FA) plans to formally withdraw its support for FIFA President Gianni Infantino, dealing him a major blow just days after he dropped his bid to sell some of his equity to private investors.

Infantino opponents threaten 'non co-operation' with Fifa

Opponents of Fifa president Gianni Infantino are threatening "non co-operation" with the governing body unless he steps down, according to senior Uefa sources.

European soccer body UEFA warns FIFA of legal action over Infantino's failed World Cup sell-off plan

European soccer body UEFA has threatened FIFA with legal action over Gianni Infantino's failed plan to sell a stake in future World Cup profits to private investors, and said any potential evidence should not be destroyed.

According to a report, UEFA, CONCACAF and the AFC are determined to force Infantino out of office by paralysing FIFA and even starting up their own competitions if he refuses to go.

corpus.signal_text:
NO CONFIDENCE: Fifa boss Infantino facing job battle over botched World Cup sale plan

The collapse of Fifa president Gianni Infantino’s unilateral $4.2-billion plan to sell World Cup rights has prompted calls from Uefa, the Confederation of North, Central America and Caribbean Association Football and others for transparency and possible legal action.

Private Investoren für die WM: Geht die FIFA zu weit?

Mit dem Plan, Anteile am WM-Geschäft an private Investoren zu verkaufen, hat die FIFA heftige Kritik auf sich gezogen. Unter Gianni Infantino setzt sie immer stärker auf Einnahmen. Ist nun eine Grenze überschritten?

FIFA stoppt Investorenpläne nach massivem Widerstand

Die FIFA gibt ihre umstrittenen Investorenpläne auf. Nach Kritik von UEFA, weiteren Verbänden und eigenen Beratern zieht Präsident Gianni Infantino den milliardenschweren Verkauf von WM-Rechten überraschend zurück.

Why Germany may stand up against FIFA's World Cup sell-off

Leading figures in German football have lined up to criticize Gianni Infantino’s plans to sell a stake in the World Cup. Germany is showing signs that they may be ready to oppose Infantino's re-election.

corpus.signal_text:
What happens next for Infantino and FIFA?

FIFA President Gianni Infantino is under pressure after the failure of his plan to create a commercial subsidiary for the World Cup. But will he be ousted? And what is needed for that to happen?

corpus.title: UEFA declares no confidence in FIFA President over failed World Cup equity plan
corpus.signal_text:
UEFA declares no confidence in FIFA President over failed World Cup equity plan

Gianni Infantino had proposed creating a $20 billion company to run the World Cup with private investors, but drew backlash that grew every day since Tuesday’s announcement. He was forced to scrap the plan early Saturday after his senior adviser who sat on a White House panel resigned and Asia’s soccer body joined Europe and North America in opposing it.
